purpose: Task-21 D0 bound for fusing each non-final MoE tail with the next layer's input RMSNorm on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-Q3_K_M decode.

sequence_accounting.method: Split each repeated 708-dispatch token sequence by launch order. Each token has 40 layer-input gguf_rmsnorm launches, 40 MoE-tail combine launches, and one final output_norm launch. Pair layer-tail combines 0..38 with input norms 1..39; leave first-layer input norm, layer-39 tail, and output_norm separate.

bound.interpretation: The fused kernel cannot remove the whole 0.2599 ms/token window because combine arithmetic and normalized output remain. It can remove 39 launches and the first RMSNorm reread of each rounded residual. A 0.3-1.0% graph-wall target remains appropriately bounded.

numerical_contract.selected_sum: Preserve the current variant: consume either a BF16 selected aggregate or slot-ordered BF16 rows plus F32 routing weights, including the intermediate activation-dtype selected-sum rounding.
numerical_contract.rounding_boundary: Store the combined activation to BF16/FP16 first; compute sum-of-squares and normalization from that rounded activation.
numerical_contract.final_layer_policy: Keep the final MoE tail and output_norm separate initially.

required_variants: BF16 activation + F32 GGUF norm weight, already-weighted selected aggregate
BF16 activation + F32 GGUF norm weight, slot-weighted selected rows
FP16 activation + FP16 PARO norm weight, already-weighted selected aggregate
FP16 activation + FP16 PARO norm weight, slot-weighted selected rows
implementation_gate.required_correctness: Bit-exact raw residual and normalized buffers against the unfused combine then RMSNorm chain, plus exact Q3/Q4/PARO trajectories and transition coverage.
implementation_gate.required_performance: Repeatable 512/4K graph decode gain; no prefill path change for decode-only promotion.
